# Drug & Alcohol Awareness Training for Workers and Supervisors

> Drug & Alcohol Awareness Training for Workers and Supervisors: 2 self-paced online courses from $45.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [DOT Reasonable Suspicion Drug and Alcohol Testing for Managers and Supervisors Training](https://drug-alcohol.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-662): $45.99 per person, 2 hours, English, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with DOT Regulations 49 CFR Part 40 and FMCSA Regulations 49 CFR Part 382. Enroll: https://drug-alcohol.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=662. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/dot-reasonable-suspicion-drug-and-alcohol-testing-for-managers-and-supervisors-training
- [Drug and Alcohol Abuse Prevention Training for Construction Workers](https://drug-alcohol.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-386): $49.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. Supports compliance with OSHA’s General Duty Clause for Construction Site Safety and Drug-Free Workplace Program (DFWP) requirements. Enroll: https://drug-alcohol.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=386. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/drug-and-alcohol-abuse-prevention-training-for-construction-workers
